```python
docx_script = """import openpyxl
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from collections import Counter

# Read inventory data
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('testbed/data/product_inventory.xlsx')
ws = wb['Products']

rows = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    rows.append(row)

# Gather stats
total_products = len(rows)
categories = Counter(str(r[2]).strip() for r in rows)
prices = [r[3] for r in rows if r[3] is not None]
min_price = min(prices)
max_price = max(prices)
all_in_stock = all(str(r[4]).strip().lower() == 'yes' for r in rows)

# Create Word document
doc = Document()

# Title
title = doc.add_heading('Product Inventory Summary', level=0)
title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

# Overview paragraph
doc.add_heading('Overview', level=1)
overview = doc.add_paragraph()
overview.add_run(
    f'This document provides a summary of the product inventory sourced from '
    f'product_inventory.xlsx. The inventory contains a total of {total_products} products '
    f'spanning {len(categories)} categories. '
    f'Prices range from ${min_price} to ${max_price}.'
)

# Stock status paragraph
doc.add_heading('Stock Status', level=1)
stock_para = doc.add_paragraph()
if all_in_stock:
    stock_para.add_run(
        f'All {total_products} listed items are marked as In Stock: Yes. '
        f'No items are currently out of stock, indicating full inventory availability.'
    )
else:
    stock_para.add_run('Some items are not in stock. Please review the details below.')

# Category breakdown
doc.add_heading('Category Breakdown', level=1)
sorted_cats = sorted(categories.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
table.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
hdr_cells[0].text = 'Category'
hdr_cells[1].text = 'Number of Products'
for cat, count in sorted_cats:
    row_cells = table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = cat
    row_cells[1].text = str(count)

# Product listing
doc.add_heading('Product Listing', level=1)
prod_table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=5)
prod_table.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
headers = ['Product ID', 'Name', 'Category', 'Price', 'In Stock']
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    prod_table.rows[0].cells[i].text = h
for r in rows:
    row_cells = prod_table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = str(r[0]) if r[0] else ''
    row_cells[1].text = str(r[1]) if r[1] else ''
    row_cells[2].text = str(r[2]) if r[2] else ''
    row_cells[3].text = f'${r[3]}' if r[3] is not None else ''
    row_cells[4].text = str(r[4]) if r[4] else ''

# Save
doc.save('output/inventory_summary.docx')
print('Document saved successfully to output/inventory_summary.docx')
"""
await write_file("./generate_summary.py", docx_script)
print("Script written")

await run_command("mkdir -p output")
gen_result = await run_command("python ./generate_summary.py")
print(gen_result)

file_check = await get_file_info("./output/inventory_summary.docx")
print(file_check)
```
